text_overrides.ordinary_2: Not too bad. There's always a tool that needs mending.
text_overrides.content_2: I'm well. I like making a tool that'll last.
text_overrides.stressed_1: I've got too much to think about.
text_overrides.stressed_2: A bit worn down. I can't seem to stop worrying.
text_overrides.stressed_3: I'm having trouble keeping my mind on anything.
